title: FolderNest v2.0.8 Official Release
changelog: • Clean UI Actions: Simplified Update button to clean 'UPDATE NOW' action.
• Streamlined Installer: Clean 'Installed Successfully!' completion dialog and polished interface.
• Remember Last Root Smart Isolation: When ON, keeps your primary designated root folder even when right-clicking inside subdirectories.
• Current Location Mode: When Remember Last Root is OFF, automatically uses the current location as the root directory.
• Window Title & Branding: Updated to FolderNest 2.0.8 across all interfaces.
• New Radiant Red & Fiery Orange 3D Icon: Ultra-visible warm glowing folder & golden rocket logo.
• Windows Right-Click Integration: Instant project creation from Explorer context menus.
